tracks.name: Paid Fixes & Automation
tracks.goal: Convert existing buyer intent into the first paid ForgeHQ-assisted coding deliveries.
targetShapes: small internal tools with objective acceptance tests
hardGates: A real current buyer or listing exists.
Scope is bounded enough to estimate and test before delivery.
The owner can describe experience truthfully without pretending to be a senior specialist.
ForgeHQ can perform substantial production work with human QA.
No ToS evasion, stealth scraping, credential abuse or high-stakes regulated decision-making is required.
A deterministic or observable acceptance test can be written before implementation.
reject: live emergency access as the only debugging method
roles requiring years of experience or credentials the owner does not have
work dependent on bypassing platform security controls

tracks.name: WordPress Micro-Products
tracks.goal: Turn repeated verified pain into small reusable assets with marketplace distribution and paid expansion.
hardGates: Current install/search demand or direct willingness-to-pay evidence exists.
The exact job is not already solved well by a maintained free plugin.
The first wedge is narrow, useful and independently testable.
A paid expansion is credible without crippling the free version.
Security and support burden are manageable.
No implementation begins while the candidate is only an idea.

currentCandidate.buyer: WooCommerce operators who need repeat-customer context while handling an order
currentCandidate.evidence: There is direct willingness-to-pay evidence for onsite customer summary information, but existing plugins already provide generic totals, AOV, first-order date and average interval metrics.
currentCandidate.requiredWedge: Operational context inside the order workflow rather than another analytics dashboard: repeat/reorder cadence, product progression, intervention flags and relevant history where the operator is already working.
currentCandidate.killCondition: Kill or reposition if a maintained free plugin already solves the same order-screen workflow well, or if no repeated buyer evidence can be found.

execution: collect exact buyer complaints and feature requests
